row.body: I saved the cloth with milky water for you. The crop plot crew passed Saturday near lunch; two hens went still, and afterward the lane was closed.
row.title: Saturday near lunch — milky water

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same milky water while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
